en: Adding a movable pulley to a fixed pulley halves the effort force needed to lift a heavy load like a flag.
Matchsticks ignite because striking them creates enough friction to generate the heat needed to combust the phosphorus on the tip.
The Moon's gravity is only one-sixth of Earth's, meaning a 60-pound child would weigh just 10 pounds there.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north tip of a compass attracts it.
A single bolt of lightning contains enough electrical energy to toast about 100,000 slices of bread.
Because light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, sunlight takes exactly eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach Earth.
Sound travels over four times faster in water than in air, allowing whales to communicate across vast ocean distances.
The Sun's heat reaches Earth through radiation across the vacuum of space, requiring absolutely no physical matter to travel.
Your body converts the chemical potential energy stored in food into kinetic energy every time you run or jump.
A steering wheel acts as a wheel and axle, allowing a small force on the rim to easily turn the shaft.
A moving car continues forward when you hit the brakes because of inertia, which resists any sudden change in motion.
Electromagnets in junkyards can lift heavy cars, but turning off the electric current instantly drops the metal.
